items.note: "a kickoff for engineering and design leads on a B2B note-taking app"
The prompt names engineering and design leads as the readers, for a kickoff.
In-scope items listed: create a workspace, invite members by email, shared notes inside a workspace.
Out-of-scope items listed: billing changes, SSO, guest access.
The metric is given as 20% of paid accounts creating a workspace within 60 days. The prompt adds "of launch", which is a small interpretation.
Migration of existing shared notes stays an open question, with the instruction "do not recommend or decide."

invented: The kickoff decision is "whether to commit to building team workspaces, and what v1 includes". The user only said the PRD is for a kickoff and never said what decision it supports.
